tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Free overview of the Base USDC Receivables Auditor, including dual-RPC safe-finality policy, fail-ambiguous matching, scan limits and the per-batch credit cost.

tools.name: get_payment_info
tools.description: Free instructions for buying this service's prepaid credits with direct native Base USDC. The funding transfer is separate from receivables being audited.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Check the remaining prepaid credits for the bearer token configured on this MCP connection. This call is free and does not consume credits.

tools.name: reconcile_usdc_receivables
tools.description: Scan a bounded Base Mainnet block range for native Circle USDC transfers into one receiver, require exact agreement from two public RPCs at safe finality, and compare them with up to 25 expected receivables. Returns matched, missing, underpaid, overpaid, wrong-sender, late, duplicate and needs-revie

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_credit_balance" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
